question: Should Workspaces ship these two builtins now, including an actionable pending-widget approval queue wherever the operator Workspaces view renders?
rationale: This is new user-facing Workspaces surface and exposes an existing security-sensitive decision path; tests can validate implementation mechanics but cannot choose the intended approval UX or sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor after fixes
options.body: Accept the two-widget direction after session-event refresh, real browser proof, and explicit operator-only authorization verification are complete.

options.title: Ship status only
options.body: Keep the read-only agent-status widget and defer the actionable approvals queue until its placement and authorization UX are separately approved.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the roadmap issues open but close or defer this implementation until Workspaces operations-widget direction has clearer maintainer sponsorship.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after fixes
recommendation.body: Accept the two-widget direction after session-event refresh, real browser proof, and explicit operator-only authorization verification are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This account was explicitly brought into the PR discussion and is the strongest available signal for the cross-cutting product/security choice.
